_comment: LEVEL 5 (stack): fullstack SaaS — backend (auth+tenancy+billing+search+CRUD) + frontend shell. No new code: pure composition. Billing+tenancy+search-infra are the widening you requested (stack-saas ties them together).
name: stack-saas
description: Fullstack SaaS: FastAPI (JWT auth + tenancy + billing subscriptions + search-infra + CRUD) + React shell (layout, login, dashboard). One apply for a subscription + multi-tenant product.

variables.name: project_name
variables.description: Project folder name, e.g. 'acme-saas' (drives package dir and stack inference)

variables.name: app_name
variables.description: Python package name, e.g. 'app' (for nested imports)

variables.name: feature_name
variables.description: Demo resource for the CRUD slice, e.g. 'Product' or 'Item' (avoid 'User')

notes: After applying stack-saas: 1) set JWT_SECRET + SEARCH_URL/SEARCH_API_KEY in .env, 2) import every new model in main.py so Base.metadata.create_all creates tables (users, tenants, plans, subscriptions, invoices), 3) app.include_router for each new router (auth, tenants, billing, search, <feature_name>), 4) scope business queries with tenancy.scoped() and protect billing create with require_role('admin'), 5) pair feature-search-infra index calls from your CRUD service. Stack is pure composition — re-apply is safe (skips byte-identical files, now reports = unchanged).
